# Frontend and platform — the rules in force

Loaded with `apps/admin`, `apps/customer`, `packages/ui` and the eight platform packages. Each line names the record it comes from; open that record when the line is not enough. Which windows are open and which records are in force is stated once, in [the ledger](../plan/README.md#the-window).

- **Where the machinery lives** — The behavioural machinery is packages, not app code: `@repo/api-client` (client, session, CSRF, URL⇄query), `@repo/i18n`, `@repo/resource`, `@repo/grid`, `@repo/form`, `@repo/app-services`, `@repo/app-kit` (the provider stack, the auth and account layouts, the app loader, the top-level error boundary, the router defaults, the app i18n factory, and the SPA test harness behind its own `testing` entry) and `@repo/account` (the account's client: the settings entity and gate, the preference cards, password recovery and the shared profile forms). An app keeps what a door cannot bind with a value — the binding of the settings gate, its router, route tree, dictionary, policy data, config and size budget. — [ADR-0051](../adr/0051-platform-extraction.md) (platform extraction) as carried by [ADR-0062](../adr/0062-frontend-build-and-shared-composition.md) and [ADR-0077](../adr/0077-shared-composition-second-wave.md), [ADR-0062](../adr/0062-frontend-build-and-shared-composition.md) (frontend build and shared app composition) as carried by [ADR-0073](../adr/0073-review-hardening.md) and [ADR-0076](../adr/0076-the-native-compiler.md) and [ADR-0077](../adr/0077-shared-composition-second-wave.md), [ADR-0077](../adr/0077-shared-composition-second-wave.md) (shared composition, second wave)
- **The session and the root in the kit** — `@repo/app-kit` holds the session provider with its unreachable notice, the principal-cache boundary and the root composition that orders the providers, each parameterised by what differed between the apps: the segment, the notice's sentence, the function that derives the cache key from a principal, and slots for the providers the kit does not own. An app's `app/providers/session.tsx`, `principal-cache.tsx` and `app/index.tsx` are bindings. The kit learns no route name, no resource name and no policy; the router, the route tree and `test/render` stay in the apps. A package's behaviour is certified in the package, and a door's own suite is a smoke test of the binding. — [ADR-0077](../adr/0077-shared-composition-second-wave.md) (shared composition, second wave), [ADR-0062](../adr/0062-frontend-build-and-shared-composition.md) (frontend build and shared app composition) as carried by [ADR-0073](../adr/0073-review-hardening.md) and [ADR-0076](../adr/0076-the-native-compiler.md) and [ADR-0077](../adr/0077-shared-composition-second-wave.md)
- **The account package** — `@repo/account` names the account's own resources — settings, profile, credentials — and no other. It depends downward only, on `@repo/app-kit` never and on `@repo/grid` never; what it needs from either arrives as a parameter or a slot. Navigation leaves it as callbacks and rendered children. It ships its own namespace, and copy the two apps word differently stays in the app and arrives as a key. What one segment alone has stays in that app. — [ADR-0077](../adr/0077-shared-composition-second-wave.md) (shared composition, second wave), [ADR-0045](../adr/0045-user-settings.md) (user settings) as carried by [ADR-0053](../adr/0053-account-area.md) and [ADR-0077](../adr/0077-shared-composition-second-wave.md), [ADR-0053](../adr/0053-account-area.md) (the account area) as carried by [ADR-0077](../adr/0077-shared-composition-second-wave.md), [ADR-0051](../adr/0051-platform-extraction.md) (platform extraction) as carried by [ADR-0062](../adr/0062-frontend-build-and-shared-composition.md) and [ADR-0077](../adr/0077-shared-composition-second-wave.md)
- **Doors** — An app reaches a platform package only through its own `shared/` door; `no-restricted-imports` refuses the package path anywhere else. A door is the only path to those symbols — not one slice per package, since a slice may front several — so the door blocks are generated per slice from each app's `DOORS` table. A feature package's door is a feature or entity slice rather than a `shared/` slice, and a page's imports do not change. The invariant is unchanged: a door is exempt from its own groups and from no others. — [ADR-0051](../adr/0051-platform-extraction.md) (platform extraction) as carried by [ADR-0062](../adr/0062-frontend-build-and-shared-composition.md) and [ADR-0077](../adr/0077-shared-composition-second-wave.md), [ADR-0062](../adr/0062-frontend-build-and-shared-composition.md) (frontend build and shared app composition) as carried by [ADR-0073](../adr/0073-review-hardening.md) and [ADR-0076](../adr/0076-the-native-compiler.md) and [ADR-0077](../adr/0077-shared-composition-second-wave.md), [ADR-0077](../adr/0077-shared-composition-second-wave.md) (shared composition, second wave)
- **Design system** — shadcn/ui in `@repo/ui` on Tailwind v4, reached only through the `shared/ui` door. The design speaks through three surfaces — the token sheet, the hand-written compositions, and the grid's own styling; a need none of the three can meet is an owned edit carrying its comment, or a finding for the record, never a quiet restyle of a generated primitive. — [ADR-0047](../adr/0047-ui-package-scope.md) (UI package scope and compositions) as carried by [ADR-0074](../adr/0074-review-follow-ups.md), [ADR-0054](../adr/0054-design-language-instrument.md) (design language "Instrument") as carried by [ADR-0080](../adr/0080-interface-polish.md)
- **Tokens** — Colour, radius, type and spacing come from tokens; a raw hex or an arbitrary `oklch()` in a component is the defect. The neutrals and the primary sit on one hue at low chroma, borders are solid rather than alpha in dark, and four tokens extend shadcn's set. — [ADR-0054](../adr/0054-design-language-instrument.md) (design language "Instrument") as carried by [ADR-0080](../adr/0080-interface-polish.md)
- **The auth card** — `@repo/app-kit`'s auth layout is one card, centred on both axes on a gradient ground between `--background` and `--primary-tint`, holding the brand line, the heading, the lede and the page's body — its controls, then its ways out. A page under it draws no card of its own, and the ground carries no inline paint. — [ADR-0080](../adr/0080-interface-polish.md) (interface polish), [ADR-0054](../adr/0054-design-language-instrument.md) (design language "Instrument") as carried by [ADR-0080](../adr/0080-interface-polish.md)
- **Generated versus written UI** — Primitives under `packages/ui/src/components/` and `src/hooks/` stay byte-identical to the CLI output and are prettier-exempt; an edit to one earns itself with a comment naming the rule that forced it. Hand-written compositions live in `src/compositions/` under the ordinary regime and are presentation-only: no contracts import, no routing, no forms, no session — and no `"use client"` directive, which a consumer that needs one reintroduces by its own record. — [ADR-0047](../adr/0047-ui-package-scope.md) (UI package scope and compositions) as carried by [ADR-0074](../adr/0074-review-follow-ups.md), [ADR-0074](../adr/0074-review-follow-ups.md) (review follow-ups)
- **Architecture** — FSD layers `app → pages → widgets → features → entities → shared` with downward-only imports enforced by lint, and file-based routes. An entity may not import another entity — the feature layer is where two entities meet. — [ADR-0049](../adr/0049-admin-app-architecture.md) (admin app architecture) as carried by [ADR-0051](../adr/0051-platform-extraction.md) and [ADR-0062](../adr/0062-frontend-build-and-shared-composition.md), [ADR-0051](../adr/0051-platform-extraction.md) (platform extraction) as carried by [ADR-0062](../adr/0062-frontend-build-and-shared-composition.md) and [ADR-0077](../adr/0077-shared-composition-second-wave.md), [ADR-0062](../adr/0062-frontend-build-and-shared-composition.md) (frontend build and shared app composition) as carried by [ADR-0073](../adr/0073-review-hardening.md) and [ADR-0076](../adr/0076-the-native-compiler.md) and [ADR-0077](../adr/0077-shared-composition-second-wave.md)
- **Session** — Credentials live in memory only — no token, CSRF token or principal in `localStorage`, `sessionStorage` or a client-set cookie; non-credential display state may be persisted. Refresh is single-flight, the CSRF token comes from the bootstrap endpoint, its cookie is named per population, and the client never reads `document.cookie`. — [ADR-0033](../adr/0033-browser-api-client-and-session.md) (browser API client and session) as carried by [ADR-0051](../adr/0051-platform-extraction.md), [ADR-0051](../adr/0051-platform-extraction.md) (platform extraction) as carried by [ADR-0062](../adr/0062-frontend-build-and-shared-composition.md) and [ADR-0077](../adr/0077-shared-composition-second-wave.md), [ADR-0030](../adr/0030-csrf-bootstrap-endpoint.md) (CSRF bootstrap endpoint), [ADR-0056](../adr/0056-per-population-csrf-cookie.md) (A CSRF cookie per population) as carried by [ADR-0064](../adr/0064-brand-seams.md)
- **The drawer toggle** — The shell renders its own drawer toggle rather than the generated `SidebarTrigger`, reading the sidebar's context — `open` on a wide screen, `openMobile` on a narrow one — and shows it twice: a panel-close icon while the drawer is open and a panel-open one while it is closed, and `aria-expanded`. Its accessible name stays the `UiStrings` sentence. — [ADR-0080](../adr/0080-interface-polish.md) (interface polish)
- **Server state** — TanStack Query owns all server state through per-entity key factories — never an inline key. Outcomes are declared in typed mutation `meta` and delivered by one global handler; queries are silent and render their own failure panel. List state lives in the URL in the API's own query language through the shared codec; a record URL carries only the record, and the way back travels as history state. — [ADR-0043](../adr/0043-readable-list-search-params.md) (server state, notifications, and one query language for both the URL and the wire), [ADR-0044](../adr/0044-record-routes-without-list-state.md) (record routes and edit surfaces)
- **Resource configs** — One `ResourceConfig<TRow, TCreate, TUpdate>` per resource — serializable config plus named registries — drives both the grid and the config-driven forms over the contracts schemas; every field is disabled while a mutation is pending, and copy in a config is a translation key. Columns are keyed by the row and fields by either body; the claims no type can make are one call of `assertConfigMatchesContract`. — [ADR-0035](../adr/0035-config-driven-resource-ui.md) (config-driven resource UI) as carried by [ADR-0063](../adr/0063-typed-resource-configs-and-generators.md), [ADR-0063](../adr/0063-typed-resource-configs-and-generators.md) (typed resource configs and generators)
- **The grid** — A grid page is a height budget with one scroll container, a sticky header and a static pager, every wrapper down to the grid carrying `flex flex-col flex-1 min-h-0` and nothing on that path clipping. Capability flags say what a surface offers and `can(action, resource)` says who may use it, conjoined once per screen so the grid never learns a resource name. A header cell's name is a start-aligned label that sorts nothing; its controls sit at the cell's end, sort then filter, one pair of ghost icon buttons, the sort named `Sort by <header>` and showing the direction it holds. There is no filter row: a filterable column gets a header dialog that commits on Apply, hot filters are toolbar stances, and the applied-filters bar renders from the URL. Create and the Columns control sit in the page-header band. Bulk delete is a bounded client-side fan-out with per-item refusals. — [ADR-0037](../adr/0037-grid-viewport-layout.md) (grid viewport layout) as carried by [ADR-0054](../adr/0054-design-language-instrument.md), [ADR-0038](../adr/0038-grid-selection-and-capabilities.md) (row selection, capabilities and the grid toolbar) as carried by [ADR-0054](../adr/0054-design-language-instrument.md), [ADR-0039](../adr/0039-grid-filter-ux.md) (filter UX) as carried by [ADR-0052](../adr/0052-grid-and-admin-followups.md) and [ADR-0080](../adr/0080-interface-polish.md), [ADR-0041](../adr/0041-grid-preferences.md) (persisted grid preferences) as carried by [ADR-0054](../adr/0054-design-language-instrument.md) and [ADR-0064](../adr/0064-brand-seams.md), [ADR-0042](../adr/0042-client-side-authorization.md) (client-side authorization), [ADR-0052](../adr/0052-grid-and-admin-followups.md) (grid and admin follow-ups) as carried by [ADR-0054](../adr/0054-design-language-instrument.md) and [ADR-0057](../adr/0057-impersonation-sessions.md) and [ADR-0062](../adr/0062-frontend-build-and-shared-composition.md), [ADR-0054](../adr/0054-design-language-instrument.md) (design language "Instrument") as carried by [ADR-0080](../adr/0080-interface-polish.md), [ADR-0080](../adr/0080-interface-polish.md) (interface polish)
- **What owns what** — The URL owns view state, preferences own ergonomics, history state owns the way back, and the table owns nothing durable. Preferences, theme, locale and row density are an account fact with `localStorage` as the cache in front, and the preference store never learns that a grid id is on the wire. Density is a mode rather than a scale, moving the row height, the cell padding and the in-row badge and nothing else. — [ADR-0041](../adr/0041-grid-preferences.md) (persisted grid preferences) as carried by [ADR-0054](../adr/0054-design-language-instrument.md) and [ADR-0064](../adr/0064-brand-seams.md), [ADR-0043](../adr/0043-readable-list-search-params.md) (server state, notifications, and one query language for both the URL and the wire), [ADR-0044](../adr/0044-record-routes-without-list-state.md) (record routes and edit surfaces), [ADR-0054](../adr/0054-design-language-instrument.md) (design language "Instrument") as carried by [ADR-0080](../adr/0080-interface-polish.md)
- **The account area** — One `/account` route family with sections; the account menu is identity and exit only, the quick controls live in preferences, and the sidebar carries no account entry. — [ADR-0053](../adr/0053-account-area.md) (the account area) as carried by [ADR-0077](../adr/0077-shared-composition-second-wave.md)
- **Copy** — Two localized catalogues: error codes in the `errors` namespace, typed complete over `ErrorCode`, and field rules as zod's own messages through the client-side error map. The API's `error.message` is never rendered. Every operator-facing string is a typed key — a literal in JSX fails lint. `@repo/ui` gains no i18n dependency; its strings arrive through the `UiStrings` context. — [ADR-0046](../adr/0046-interface-localization.md) (interface localization) as carried by [ADR-0064](../adr/0064-brand-seams.md)
- **Brand seams** — The app identifier is configuration, not a literal: the API derives its cookie names and token audience from it, and each SPA derives every device-storage key as `${appId}.${segment}.${fact}` through parameters on the packages that store anything. — [ADR-0064](../adr/0064-brand-seams.md) (brand seams)
- **Testing** — Vitest, Testing Library and MSW with handlers derived from the contracts; no live-API tier, because a mock more permissive than the service certifies the opposite of production. Assertions go by accessible name in English, and the pseudo-locale suite proves no literal survived. — [ADR-0036](../adr/0036-admin-testing-strategy.md) (admin app testing strategy) as carried by [ADR-0052](../adr/0052-grid-and-admin-followups.md), [ADR-0052](../adr/0052-grid-and-admin-followups.md) (grid and admin follow-ups) as carried by [ADR-0054](../adr/0054-design-language-instrument.md) and [ADR-0057](../adr/0057-impersonation-sessions.md) and [ADR-0062](../adr/0062-frontend-build-and-shared-composition.md)
- **Build and budget** — Packages stay source-only and Vite consumes `src`; project references add a declarations-only build for type-checking, emitted where nothing resolves to it at runtime. Vendor groups are explicit chunks, sourcemaps are hidden, and each SPA's budget carries per-chunk ceilings beside its totals. — [ADR-0002](../adr/0002-monorepo-layout-and-tooling.md) (monorepo layout and tooling) as carried by [ADR-0062](../adr/0062-frontend-build-and-shared-composition.md) and [ADR-0073](../adr/0073-review-hardening.md), [ADR-0062](../adr/0062-frontend-build-and-shared-composition.md) (frontend build and shared app composition) as carried by [ADR-0073](../adr/0073-review-hardening.md) and [ADR-0076](../adr/0076-the-native-compiler.md) and [ADR-0077](../adr/0077-shared-composition-second-wave.md)
- **Budget headroom** — Every ceiling in a `size-budget.json` is at most 15% over its committed baseline, enforced by `scripts/size.mjs`, and a diff that raises a ceiling re-measures its baseline, so a raise always shows both numbers; a measurement more than ten percent over its baseline is reported beside the table and never fails the link. The entry stays lean by declaration rather than by a raise: a rendering package the composition root imports by barrel declares `sideEffects: false` when nothing in it acts on import. — [ADR-0073](../adr/0073-review-hardening.md) (review hardening) as carried by [ADR-0074](../adr/0074-review-follow-ups.md) and [ADR-0076](../adr/0076-the-native-compiler.md)
- **The content policy** — Both SPA images send a Content-Security-Policy from `nginx.conf`: scripts from `'self'` only, styles from `'self'` plus `'unsafe-inline'` (Tailwind's stated price), `connect-src` the API origin substituted from `VITE_API_URL` and refused unless it is `scheme://host[:port]`, `object-src 'none'`, `frame-ancestors 'none'`. A built `index.html` carries no inline script, inline style element or event-handler attribute, checked after `size`'s build; an origin a fork adds goes in `nginx.conf`. — [ADR-0073](../adr/0073-review-hardening.md) (review hardening) as carried by [ADR-0074](../adr/0074-review-follow-ups.md) and [ADR-0076](../adr/0076-the-native-compiler.md), [ADR-0074](../adr/0074-review-follow-ups.md) (review follow-ups)
- **Impersonation in a new tab** — The confirm opens a blank tab synchronously inside the click, mints, then disowns the tab's `opener` before navigating it to the handoff; a refused mint closes the tab and keeps the confirm with its toast, and a browser that refuses the open falls back to the same tab. — [ADR-0070](../adr/0070-impersonation-in-a-new-tab.md) (impersonation opens the customer app in a new tab), [ADR-0057](../adr/0057-impersonation-sessions.md) (impersonation sessions) as carried by [ADR-0067](../adr/0067-organizations.md) and [ADR-0070](../adr/0070-impersonation-in-a-new-tab.md) and [ADR-0071](../adr/0071-mail-flows.md) and [ADR-0072](../adr/0072-federated-identity-google-sign-in.md)
- **Invalidation** — A mutation invalidates its own entity's keys; the feature invalidates whatever else the interaction touched. — [ADR-0043](../adr/0043-readable-list-search-params.md) (server state, notifications, and one query language for both the URL and the wire)
